_source: UK Food Standards Agency (FSA) consumer and caterer guidance, checked 8 Nov 2026. https://www.food.gov.uk/safety-hygiene/cooking-your-food

mince.text: 70°C for 2 min, or 75°C for 30 s, at the centre

poultry.text: 70°C for 2 min, or 75°C for 30 s. No pink meat, juices run clear

pork.text: 70°C for 2 min, or 75°C for 30 s. No pink meat

rolled.text: Rolled joints must be cooked all the way through

whole_red.text: Whole cuts of beef and lamb can be cooked to preference once all outside surfaces are cooked

fish.text: Cook until the flesh turns opaque and flakes easily. Cook it fully if you serve someone pregnant, elderly, very young or with a weak immune system

leftovers.text: Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours. Eat within 2 days. Reheat once, until steaming hot all through

rice.text: Cooked rice: serve it hot. Cool leftovers within 1 hour, keep them in the fridge, eat within 1 day and reheat only once

raw_mix.text: Do not taste raw batter or dough. Raw flour and raw egg can carry harmful bacteria

hot_hold.text: Food kept warm should stay steaming hot (63°C or above) and be eaten within 2 hours
